I pasted the address and pressed Save — it thought for a moment, then a card appeared with the site icon and name, a clear title, a short description, a preview image, the URL, and a "just now" time stamp. That's exactly the transformation I was hoping for: a plain link comes back looking like something I'd actually recognize later.

The composition feels right to me — the preview and title draw the eye first, and the description and site line give me the context, with the URL there when I need it. That's the heart of what I wanted from saving, so I'm happy with this direction.

One note for later, not a change to this screen: I'm assuming the title and description will be things I can edit if the auto-collected version isn't quite right. No need to show it now — just keep it in mind as we go.
